query:
SELECT t.name, pt.projectId, pt.tagId
FROM projectTags pt
JOIN tags t ON pt.tagId = t.id
JOIN projects p ON pt.projectId = p.id
WHERE p.slug = 'the-glass-menagerie'
ORDER BY t.name;
